messages:
zara_cs: Kicking off Copperfield onboarding (pilot -> gated prod ~3w). Need owners for SSO, export schema, perf run, and a short renewal one-pager. Quick check-in to lock owners and high risks.

simon_impl: I can lead integration (SAML e2e + daily export). Quick Q: pilot needs SAML only or also SCIM?

rachel_eng: From infra: SAML only for pilot is fine. I'll own staging perf and the 48h pilot load window. Heads-up: they use some 7k+ token prompts in a synthesis flow.

lucas_pm: Product success criteria: (1) SSO validated with test users; (2) daily CSV export to their Snowflake schema validated; (3) median chat latency <250ms and embedding p95 <2s during the 48h pilot; (4) clear cost-per-10k-tokens doc for finance. Exec demo should highlight cost delta vs incumbent.

ethan_renewals: Renewal context: account renews in Q4. Primary risk is unpredictable token spend. I'll prepare a one-pager showing baseline comparison and projected savings if quantized models pass QA.

zara_cs: Proposed owners: Zara = CS lead, Simon = Integration, Rachel = Eng perf, Lucas = PM liaison, Ethan = Renewal liaison. Any conflicts?

simon_impl: none. I'll draft an integration checklist (IdP metadata, signed assertions flag, sample rows) and include route_id + token_count in CSV schema.

rachel_eng: I'll spin up a staging route and run two 24h passes (interactive profile + overnight batch). Need sample traffic shape from Lucas. Also will run A/B: full-precision vs quantized for cost/quality.

lucas_pm: Sending traffic profile and anonymization instructions in DM. Copperfield will redact PII and prefers we supply a small sanitize script.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Copperfield Internal Onboard Prep" Thu 11am PT  invite sent.

zara_cs: Actions for today: 1) Simon: integration checklist + data contract (EOD). 2) Rachel: staging perf plan + A/B template. 3) Lucas: traffic profile + anonymization plan. 4) Ethan: renewal one-pager draft. 5) Zara: request IdP metadata and baseline spend from customer. Will run internal sync before customer kickoff. Thanks! :tada:
